messages:
alex (eng-platform): quick contract question about chat/completions endpoint — can we align on a couple of things before the SDK PR? :eyes:

alex (eng-platform): 1) messages schema: do we require `name` on assistant/user/system entries, or optional? product asked for explicit names for routing to tools.

raj (eng-ml): prefer keeping name optional for backwards compat. only require `role` (`system|user|assistant|tool`). if `name` present we treat it as identifier for tool routing.

alex (eng-platform): ok — so tools will only be routed when a message has both role: "tool" and name set?

liam (eng-runtime): minor tweak: runtime needs either (role=="tool") OR messages[i].metadata.target == "tool:<name>" for legacy requests. we should document both but prioritize `role`+`name`.

alex (eng-platform): got it. 2) function/tool-calling params: product wants `arguments` to be a JSON string, but SDK folks want a typed object. what's the contract? example we discussed: 

```
{
  "name": "get_user_profile",
  "arguments": "{\"user_id\": 123}\"
}
```

raj (eng-ml): model->tool interface historically passed a JSON-encoded string to avoid schema mismatches. i'd recommend we accept both: string OR object. Runtime will normalize to object before sending to the tool process.

alex (eng-platform): great. document will say: `arguments: string | object` and runtime normalizes. any objections?

liam (eng-runtime): agree. also add max-arg-bytes validation (default 32KB) and explicit error code `TOOL_ARG_TOO_LARGE`.

alex (eng-platform): 3) streaming fields — we have two competing patterns: per-token 'delta' chunks vs full choice updates. product prefers delta so frontends can render progressively. example expected chunk: 

```
{"id":"req-abc","object":"chat.completion.chunk","model":"rwd-13b","choices":[{"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"Hel"},"index":0,"finish_reason":null}]}
```

and final: 

```
{"id":"req-abc","object":"chat.completion.chunk","model":"rwd-13b","choices":[{"delta":{},"index":0,"finish_reason":"stop","text":"Hello"}],"done":true}
```

raj (eng-ml): that matches common patterns. small note: prefer `delta.content` as string OR parts array to support streaming rich content later.

liam (eng-runtime): runtime can support both, but we should standardize on `delta.content` being a string now and leave extension plan documented. also `done` should be boolean on the outer envelope; avoid inferring from finish_reason.

alex (eng-platform): 4) backward compatibility: if we add `tool_hint` field on messages, do we allow older clients to ignore gracefully? product wants SDKs to surface it but not break older agents.

tess (product): yes — SDKs should be conservative. we should mark `tool_hint` as optional extension. contract: unknown fields MUST be ignored by clients.

liam (eng-runtime): will implement permissive parsing. runtime will also reject requests that include both `stream:true` and `wait_for_model` (new flag) with `400` and code `INVALID_CONFLICT`.

alex (eng-platform): small request: add example response for completion (non-stream) in docs. suggested shape: 

```
{
  "id":"resp-123",
  "object":"chat.completion",
  "model":"rwd-13b",
  "choices":[
    {"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Hi"},"finish_reason":"stop"}
  ]
}
```

raj (eng-ml): thumbs up. also include embedding of tool metadata when a tool produced the output: `choices[].tool = {"name":"get_user_profile","meta":{...}}`.

alex (eng-platform): action items: 
- liam: add runtime validation rules (arg size, stream+wait conflict, legacy metadata routing) — due EOD Thursday.
- raj: write short note on delta vs parts design and recommended extension path — due Wed.
- tess: confirm product UX expectations for `name` usage and tool_hint doc blurb — due Fri.

ci-bot: deploy check passed for branch feature/chat-contract (#482) :white_check_mark:

tess (product): thanks team — i'll update the spec draft in the repo and ping once done. :raised_hands:
